browser_environment.engine: Chromium (Playwright automated browser via Antigravity browser tools)

viewport_emulation_widths_tested.label: Narrow mobile / iPhone SE short screen

browser_environment.distinction: Responsive viewport checks performed via Chromium emulation; physical devices (physical iOS/Android touch hardware, native Safari/WebKit, physical Firefox) remain distinguished and require physical hardware for sign-off.

registration_login_logout.details: Registered disposable account test_disp_user_a, verified JWT authentication, avatar 'T', username and role display, and clean logout.

four_shared_defaults.details: Every account (guest and authenticated) sees the four shared default books (Java, C, C++, Python) with 'Included for everyone' badges. Default books cannot be deleted by normal users or guests.

private_subjects.details: Created personal subject 'Robotics Systems'; duplicate subject name rejected with clear validation error; independent same-named subjects verified across distinct accounts.

pdf_upload_process_resume.details: Synthetic 1-page PDF uploaded under 'Robotics Systems', reached 'Reading PDF' active processing, polled until extraction completed (1 page / 1 chunk), safe quota stop recorded as 'partial' status, and processed document displayed in Saved PDF Books.

preferences.details: Preferences modal opens with current values; updated Explanation Level to 'Beginner', Answer Style to 'Concise', toggle code examples, and preferred subject to 'Robotics Systems'; settings persisted to backend and applied to chat.

chat_and_citations.details: Live RAG query against private book generated concise answer citing 'Autonomous Robotics Guide, PDF p. 1'; source card expanded to show exact chunk snippet; copy button successfully copies answer with Source note.

pdf_rendering_and_page_jump.details: Clicked 'View PDF' in expanded SourceCard. The browser PDF viewer launched with '#page=1', displaying the rendered PDF title, chapters, and page content.

cross_user_isolation.details: Secondary account (TechStudent2) sees only 4 default books; cannot see or search User A's private reference; direct GET /api/v1/documents/8/download returns 404; can create an independent subject with the same name.

deletion_confirmations.details: Subject deletion on-page modal cancel preserved subject; confirm permanently deleted subject, documents, and chunks, resetting preferred subject to All. Conversation deletion from sidebar verified.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Broken hover contrast and non-existent Tailwind class hover:bg-slate-850 on sample question cards. On light parchment background (#f5ede1), hover:text-white made text completely unreadable.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Replaced with hover:bg-slate-800, hover:text-slate-100, and group-hover:text-brand-700.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Missing accessible name (aria-label) on Copy Answer button and missing focus-visible keyboard outlines on copy, continue learning, and tuning bar buttons.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Added aria-label="Copy Answer" and focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500/50 styles.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Missing accessible name on View PDF link and missing focus-visible styling on expand and View PDF buttons.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Added aria-label={`View PDF for ${source.document_title} at page ${source.page_number}`} and focus-visible outline rings.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Missing accessible name on conversation delete button and missing focus-visible styling.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Added aria-label={`Delete conversation: ${c.title}`} and focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-rose-500/50 styles.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Missing aria-labels on Process Document and Delete Document buttons.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Added aria-label={`Process document ${doc.title}`} and aria-label={`Delete document ${doc.title}`} with focus-visible styles.

frontend_fixes_applied.issue: Unconditional setSystemHealth(null) during auth switch caused transient flicker to 'Knowledge Base 0' and amber 'Local study mode'.
frontend_fixes_applied.fix: Removed setSystemHealth(null) in user switch effect to preserve smooth rendering during background health verification.
